name: Roundleaf Chastetree
desc: Roundleaf Chastetree (Vitex rotundifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 19 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Vitex rotundifolia, the roundleaf chastetree or beach vitex, is a species of flowering plant in the sage family Lamiaceae. It is native to seashores throughout the Pacific.
